notes: REF-BM-02: metadata.py (fetch_metadata) captures title/description/favicon only — no og:image/preview-image extraction anywhere. REF-BM-03: AddBookmark.tsx takes only a URL; there is no pre-save preview/edit step for auto-collected title/description, only post-save editing via EditBookmark. REF-BM-04: BookmarkUpdate (api/bookmarks.py) has no `url` field — the address cannot be edited after saving, only title/description/notes/tags. REF-BM-14: search.py treats a `#`-prefixed term as a literal substring term (no stripping/tag-matching special-case), so `#tag` syntax in the search box does not filter by tag; tag filtering only exists via the separate TagFilter UI. REF-BM-15: search.py is explicitly '(deliberately tiny)': terms are ANDed substrings plus quoted phrases only — no AND/OR/NOT keyword handling and no parenthesized grouping, and consequently no quoting rule for literal operator words either. REF-BM-23: Markdown notes are only rendered in the EditBookmark modal's live preview; BookmarkList (the normal viewing surface) never renders notes/markdown. REF-BM-24: no snapshot capture (HTML or PDF) exists in the codebase. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration exists. REF-BM-32: no user-settings entity/endpoint/UI for default sort, page size, or font size — sort is only a transient per-session UI selection, not a persisted personal setting.
